verse.text: In the same way, husbands ought to love their wives as they love their own bodies. For a man who loves his wife actually shows love for himself.

video.title: A Husband's Role in Marriage | Ephesians 5:25–26 | Our Daily Bread Video Devotional

reflection: Loving your wife like your own body isn't abstract theology — it's noticing when she's exhausted and taking the kids so she can breathe, or choosing patience when you'd rather check out after a long day. A man who tends to his marriage this way is quietly teaching his kids what real love looks like, long before he ever says a word about it.
